name: Modal serverless GPU containers (per-second, autoscale to zero)
region: multi-region with a regional price multiplier (see notes)
notes: $3.95/H100-hour makes Modal the second-cheapest H100 in this slice after Runpod's PCIe, and $0.80 for L4 is the cheapest L4 published anywhere here (vs $0.85 on GCP g2 and $1.67 on AWS g6). But two modifiers on the plan table matter more than the base rate and are easy to miss: 'Region selection 1.15 - 1.75x base prices' and, more importantly, 'Non-preemptible execution 3x base prices'. If you need a container that will NOT be preempted - which for a serving endpoint you probably do - your real H100 rate is $11.85/hr, the most expensive in the slice, not $3.95. Read that row before quoting. Also note Modal bills CPU and memory separately and continuously (a physical core = 2 vCPU, $0.0000131/core/sec; memory $0.00000222/GiB/sec), so a GPU-only comparison understates the all-in cost relative to a hyperscaler VM where vCPU and RAM are bundled into the instance price. On that integrated basis Modal's H100 is not cheaper than AWS p5. What you are buying is scale-to-zero: containers spin up in 1-2 seconds with no minimum billing period and a 60-second default keepalive, versus 10+ minutes to provision a hyperscaler VM where the idle time is billable. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT, stated by Modal itself: AWS, GCP and Azure cloud credits are NOT applicable to Modal usage. Modal transacts through the AWS and GCP marketplaces for committed spend, and offers $30/mo free on Starter and $100/mo on Team, plus up to $10k for academics.
